name: file.write
description: Write content to a file. Atomic by default — content lands in a temp file then renames into place. Overwrites existing files unless `create_only: true`.

path.description: Absolute path. Parent directory must exist (use directory.create first).

content.description: Content to write. base64-encoded if encoding=binary; decoded text otherwise.

encoding.description: Encoding used to interpret `content`. `binary` decodes from base64 to raw bytes; all others encode the text into the named encoding.

atomic.description: When true, write to a temp file and rename into place (no half-written file visible to other readers). When false, writes directly to path — required for files held open by other processes via FILE_SHARE_WRITE.

create_only.description: If true, fails with ERR already_exists rather than overwriting an existing file.

bytes_written.description: Number of bytes actually written to disk (after encoding from `content`). For `encoding: binary` this equals the decoded base64 length.

encoding.description: Echo of the encoding used to write. Confirms the agent honoured the requested encoding (no silent fallback).

x-implementations.name: create_file_w_atomic
x-implementations.description: Win32 `CreateFileW` to a sibling temp file (`<path>.tmp.<random>`) + `WriteFile` + `MoveFileExW(MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH)`. NT 5+. Used when `atomic: true`.

x-implementations.name: create_file_w_direct
x-implementations.description: Win32 `CreateFileW` directly + `WriteFile`. CREATE_NEW disposition when `create_only: true`, CREATE_ALWAYS otherwise. Used when `atomic: false`.

x-implementations.name: copy_delete_fallback
x-implementations.description: 9x non-atomic fallback: write temp + CopyFile + DeleteFile. Used when MoveFileEx is unavailable.

windows-modern.description: CreateFileW + WriteFile to a sibling temp file, then atomic MoveFileExW with MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING. `create_only: true` opens with CREATE_NEW (returns ERR already_exists if the file exists). Long paths via `\\?\` prefix automatic when input exceeds MAX_PATH.

windows-classic.description: CreateFileA on NT 4 / 9x; CreateFileW on NT 5+. Atomic rename via MoveFileEx (NT 4+). 9x falls back to CopyFile + DeleteFile (NOT atomic — a concurrent reader can see the file mid-replace). Same `create_only` semantics on all classic versions via CREATE_NEW disposition.
